question: Should Testbox lease freshness accept a best-effort synchronous child timeout, or does it require a separately supervised hard deadline for the unresponsive-filesystem case?
rationale: Node's synchronous child-process contract prevents this helper-level change from proving the strict operational guarantee described in the PR, so the intended failure-model contract needs an owner decision.

options.title: Narrow the guarantee
options.body: Revise the title, body, and proof to describe a best-effort timeout for killable Git children, retaining this small helper change.

options.title: Design a supervisor boundary
options.body: Pause this PR and define an owner-level watchdog with explicit cleanup semantics if stale-filesystem hangs must be bounded end to end.

recommendation.title: Narrow the guarantee
recommendation.body: Revise the title, body, and proof to describe a best-effort timeout for killable Git children, retaining this small helper change.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged sibling change is the closest evidence-backed timeout-boundary precedent available in the supplied history.
